name: Kepler-11
blurb: A Sun-like star with six tightly packed, low-density transiting planets — one of the first systems found with six planets all crossing the star’s disk.
highlights: Six confirmed planets (b–g), all larger than Earth
Entire known system fits well inside Mercury’s orbital distance from the Sun
compactnessNote: All six planets orbit closer than Mercury does to the Sun — a packed, nearly coplanar system (archive inclinations are edge-on; Explore shows face-on).
